name: registry_book_slot
description: Protected. Book the chosen office slot. Only after reading back office, date and time and hearing a clear yes. Refused until the rules allow it (fee paid, photo received). Two-step: the first call changes nothing; after a clear yes, call again with the same arguments and the confirmation_id.

confirmation_id.description: Empty the first time; after the caller says yes, the confirmation_id you were given
